title: HeritageGraph: An Ontology for Living Heritage Systems
description:
HeritageGraph is a CIDOC-CRM-based ontology for representing living heritage systems: the networks of sites, recurring rituals, custodial institutions, people, and beliefs through which a tradition is sustained. Developed with the Kathmandu Valley (Nepal) as its case study, it provides four ontology design patterns (event-mediated tangible heritage, the Living Goddess lifecycle, provenance-aware syncretic relationships, and institutional infrastructure for Guthi trusts) and a provenance layer reusing PROV-O, CRMinf, and SKOS, with support for Bikram Sambat, Nepal Sambat, and Gregorian dates.

The ontology (66 classes, 134 properties) is generated from a single LinkML source into OWL 2, SHACL, and JSON Schema. This release includes the alignment to the Linked Art data model, a demonstrator ABox, competency-question SPARQL queries, and evaluation scripts.
